_comment: Curated current-patch meta heroes for the hero draft bot. Hand-maintained from public tier lists and tournament pick/ban data; edit freely when a new patch lands. Names must match OpenDota's localized hero names. tier S/A/B; pos = positions the hero is meta at; note = short why. OpenDota's live pub winrates (cache/hero_meta_stats) are a separate, automatic signal - this file is the human read of the patch.
sources: https://www.dota2.com/patches/7.41f (7.41f gameplay patch, live 2026-09-15: Invoker, Bounty Hunter, Treant, Earth Spirit, Centaur nerfed; Ursa buffed)
https://everythingedinburgh.com/games/gaming/best-carry-heroes-dota-2/ (7.41e carry / mid / offlane / support tier lists)

Ursa.note: highest pos-1 pub winrate on 7.41e; Maul buffed again in 7.41f

Lone Druid.note: most contested pro carry (picked/banned ~65% of drafts)

Spectre.note: safest hypercarry; joins every fight with Haunt

Sven.note: generalist carry, good into most matchups

Phantom Assassin.note: strong unless answered with MKB / Troll

Troll Warlord.note: answer to PA and the strength offlane meta

Necrophos.note: flex core, strong into tanky strength lineups

Snapfire.note: leads the mid pool; also flexed to pos 4

Earth Spirit.note: TI 2026 mid (66% WR, 38 picks); nerfed in 7.41f but still contested

Leshrac.note: tempo mid: wave clear, tower pressure

Huskar.note: most feared ranked mid below Divine - LD2L bracket

Timbersaw.note: counters the tanky strength offlane meta

Centaur Warrunner.note: most picked offlaner at TI 2026; nerfed in 7.41f

Tidehunter.note: DM and Collapse both rate it top-3

Enigma.note: DM's pick; Black Hole into grouped lineups

Hoodwink.note: most picked hero at TI 2026 (55 games)

Bounty Hunter.note: dominant pos 4 until the 7.41f Track nerf

Bane.note: S-tier pos 5; point-and-click, needs no items

Undying.note: most picked pos 5 at TI 2026 (34 games, 53%)

Treant Protector.note: most banned hero at TI 2026 (87.5% when through); trimmed in 7.41f
